en.title: House of the Dragon Finale Ignites Tumbleton, Reacher Returns for More Conspiracy
en.summary: This week's television landscape is dominated by epic conclusions and thrilling new beginnings. The highly anticipated season finale of House of the Dragon promises a brutal clash, while Reacher kicks off its new season with a fresh conspiracy.
en.body:
## The Dance of Dragons Reaches its Climax

After eight weeks of escalating tensions, dragonfire, and devastating betrayals, the **House of the Dragon** season finale is set to unleash the fury of the Dance of Dragons. Sunday night's episode will culminate in the explosive Battle at Tumbleton, a pivotal event that has fans of George R. R. Martin's **Fire & Blood** on the edge of their seats. The source material splits this massacre into two distinct events, leaving showrunners with a critical decision: will they faithfully adapt the novel's pacing, or will they condense the carnage into one spectacular, season-ending brawl for maximum dramatic impact? Regardless of the approach, the Greens, led by **James Norton**'s Ormund Hightower, and the Blacks, bolstered by the Winter Wolves and Rivermen, are poised for a brutal confrontation. Thankfully for fans, the network has already greenlit a fourth season, ensuring that some key players will undoubtedly survive the impending bloodshed, but the question remains: who, and at what cost?

## Reacher's Latest Conspiracy Unfolds

Meanwhile, Wednesday marks the return of **Alan Ritchson** as the titular drifter in **Reacher**, with the premiere of its fourth season on Prime Video. This installment dives into Lee Child's 13th Jack Reacher novel, **Gone Tomorrow**. The new season kicks off with Reacher's attempt to help a distressed woman on a Philadelphia subway, an encounter that quickly spirals into a deadly conspiracy. As is his wont, Reacher finds himself pitted against formidable and ruthless adversaries operating at the highest levels of power. Prime Video is dropping the first three episodes of the eight-episode season, giving binge-watchers plenty to sink their teeth into from the outset. The series has carved out a significant niche for itself by delivering straightforward, no-nonsense action and a compelling lead performance, and this new chapter promises to uphold that reputation with a complex plot and high stakes.

## What's Next

Beyond these major events, the television week offers a smattering of new arrivals and ongoing series. While specific premiere dates for many of 2026's scripted shows are still materializing, the anticipation for established hits and new ventures remains high. Fans can look forward to the continued exploration of beloved universes and the introduction of fresh narratives across streaming and broadcast platforms.

tr.title: Ejderhaların Evi Finali Tumbleton'u Alevlere boğuyor, Reacher Yeni Bir komployla Dönüyor
tr.summary: Bu hafta televizyon dünyası, epik sonuçlar ve heyecan verici yeni başlangıçlarla dolu. Ejderhaların Evi finali, bir çatışmayla sona erecekken, Reacher yeni sezonuyla birlikte taze bir komplo getiriyor. İzleyiciler, bu iki önemli olayı merakla bekliyor.
tr.body:
## Ejderhaların Dansı Doruğuna Ulaşıyor

Sekiz haftadır artan gerilimler, ejderha ateşi ve yıkıcı ihanetler之后, Ejderhaların Evi finali, Ejderhaların Dansı'nı ortaya koyuyor. Pazar gecesi bölümü, Tumbleton Savaşı ile sonuçlanacak ve bu, George R. R. Martin'in Ateş ve Kan adlı eserinin hayranlarını merak içinde bırakacak. Kaynak materyal bu katliamı iki ayrı olaya ayırıyor ve bu, yapımcılara önemli bir karar bırakıyor: romanın tempósunu sadık bir şekilde uyarlayacaklar mı, yoksa tüm şiddeti bir sezon finali için birleştirecekler mi? Hangi yaklaşımı seçerlerse seçsinler, **James Norton**'un Ormund Hightower liderliğindeki Yeşiller ve Kara Kaplanlar ve Nehir Adamları tarafından desteklenen Siyahlar, bir çatışmaya hazırlanıyor. Şükür ki, ağ already dördüncü sezonu onayladı ve bu, bazı önemli karakterlerin şüphesiz bu kanlı olaylardan sağ çıkacağı anlamına geliyor, ancak soru şu: kim ve ne pahasına?

## Reacher'ın Yeni Komplosu

Bu arada, **Alan Ritchson**'ın başrolde olduğu Reacher, Çarşamba günü dördüncü sezonunun galasıyla geri dönüyor. Bu sezon, Lee Child'ın 13. Jack Reacher romanı olan Yarın Gone'a dayanıyor. Yeni sezon, Reacher'ın bir Philadelphia metrosunda bir kadın yardımına koşmasıyla başlıyor ve bu, kısa sürede ölümcül bir komplo haline geliyor. Reacher, güçlü ve acımasız düşmanlarla karşı karşıya kalıyor. Prime Video, sekiz bölümlük sezonun ilk üç bölümünü yayınlayacak ve bu, izleyicilere bolca içerik sunacak. Dizi, doğrudan ve anlaşılır aksiyon ve etkileyici bir performansla kendine önemli bir yer edinmiş durumda ve bu yeni bölüm, karmaşık bir plot ve yüksek bahislerle bu üne uygun görünüyor.

## Daha Fazla

Bu önemli olayların ötesinde, televizyon haftası, yeni gelişler ve devam eden dizilerle dolu. 2026'nın senaryolu gösterilerinin çoğu için özel galası masih belum açık, ancak kurulu hitlerin ve yeni girişimlerin heyecanı yüksek. İzleyiciler, sevdikleri evrenlerin devamını ve yeni hikayelerin tanıtımını çeşitli platformlarda keşfedebilecekler.

es.title: La Casa del Dragón se Inflama: Tumbleton Arde y Reacher Regresa con más Conspiraciones
es.summary: La semana de la televisión está dominada por épicas conclusiones y emocionantes nuevos comienzos. La muy anticipada final de temporada de La Casa del Dragón promete un choque brutal, mientras que Reacher inicia su nueva temporada con una fresca conspiración. Los fanáticos de George R. R. Martin y Lee Child están a la expectativa de estos eventos que prometen mantenerlos al borde de sus asientos.
es.body:
## La Danza de los Dragones Llega a su Clímax

Después de ocho semanas de tensiones crecientes, fuego de dragón y traiciones devastadoras, la final de temporada de La Casa del Dragón está a punto de desencadenar la furia de la Danza de los Dragones. El episodio de domingo noche culminará en la explosiva Batalla de Tumbleton, un evento crucial que tiene a los fanáticos de **Fire & Blood** de George R. R. Martin al borde de sus asientos. El material original divide esta masacre en dos eventos distintos, dejando a los showrunners con una decisión crítica: ¿se ajustarán fielmente al ritmo de la novela o condensarán la carnicería en una sola y espectacular pelea para maximizar el impacto dramático? Independientemente del enfoque, los Verdes, liderados por **James Norton** como Ormund Hightower, y los Negros, fortalecidos por los Lobos de Invierno y los Hombres del Río, están preparados para un choque brutal. Afortunadamente para los fanáticos, la red ya ha aprobado una cuarta temporada, asegurando que algunos jugadores clave sobrevivirán a la inminente matanza, pero la pregunta sigue siendo: ¿quién y a qué costo?

## La Última Conspiración de Reacher se Desenvuelve

Mientras tanto, el miércoles marca el regreso de **Alan Ritchson** como el vagabundo titular en **Reacher**, con el estreno de su cuarta temporada en Prime Video. Esta entrega se sumerge en la 13ª novela de Jack Reacher de Lee Child, **Gone Tomorrow**. La nueva temporada comienza con el intento de Reacher de ayudar a una mujer angustiada en un metro de Filadelfia, un encuentro que rápidamente se convierte en una conspiración mortal. Como es su costumbre, Reacher se encuentra enfrentado a adversarios formidables y despiadados que operan en los niveles más altos del poder. Prime Video está lanzando los primeros tres episodios de la temporada de ocho episodios, dando a los fanáticos de las maratones plenty para sumergirse desde el principio. La serie ha creado un nicho significativo para sí misma al ofrecer acción directa y sin tonterías, y este nuevo capítulo promete mantener esa reputación con una trama compleja y apuestas altas.

## Próximos Pasos

Más allá de estos eventos importantes, la semana de la televisión ofrece una variedad de nuevos lanzamientos y series en curso. Aunque las fechas de estreno específicas para muchos de los programas guionizados de 2026 aún están tomando forma, la anticipación por los éxitos establecidos y las nuevas aventuras sigue siendo alta. Los fanáticos pueden esperar la continuación de la exploración de universos queridos y la introducción de narrativas frescas en plataformas de streaming y transmisión.

content_raw: Welcome to What’s On, our weekly roundup of notable shows. Here is what’s happening on TV from Sunday, August 9 to Saturday, August 15. All times are Eastern. House Of The Dragon (HBO and HBO Max, Sunday, 9 p.m., season three finale) After eight Sunday nights’ worth of fiery twists, shocking betrayals and deadly dragons, House Of The Dragon ’s third season will come to an explosive end with this week’s finale episode, which builds toward the devastating Battle at Tumbleton between the Greens (led by James Norton’s Ormund Hightower) and the Blacks (the Winter Wolves and Rivermen among them). That massacre is split into two events in George R. R. Martin’s Fire & Blood , so it remains to be seen if the HBO drama remains faithful to the source material or cherry picks the bloodiest bits for one big season-ending brawl. The Game Of Thrones prequel has already been picked up for a fourth season, so at least some characters have to survive, right? Stick around for The A.V. Club ’s review and more coverage of the season’s final episode. Reacher (Prime Video, Wednesday, season four premiere) Based on Gone Tomorrow, the 13th of Lee Child’s Jack Reacher novels, the latest installment of this Amazon action-crime thriller sees Reacher (Alan Ritchson) drawn into a complex and deadly conspiracy after trying to help a distraught woman on the Philadelphia subway. When that chance encounter goes horribly wrong, the titular vigilante finds himself warring with “ruthless foes from the highest echelons of power,” per the streamer. The first three episodes of the eight-ep season drop on Wednesday; look out for The A.V. Club ’s season review on Tuesday. My Brilliant Career (Netflix, Thursday, series premiere) Adapted from Miles Franklin’s classic 1901 novel, this six-part Australian drama stars Philippa Northeast as Sybylla Melvyn, a fiercely modern farm girl who dreams of becoming a writer. Those lofty professional ambitions butt up against societal pressures and her family’s insistence that Sybylla settle down and marry, a tension that gets even more complicated when she unexpectedly falls for her hunky young neighbor Harry (Christopher Chung). Anna Chancellor, Genevieve O’Reilly, and Kate Mulvany round out the historical drama’s cast. Also arriving The Chosen In the Wild With Bear Grylls (Prime Video, Sunday, series premiere) The Real Housewives Ultimate Girls Trip: Roaring 20th (Bravo, Sunday, 9 p.m., season five premiere) Tires (Netflix, Thursday, season three premiere) MLB Field of Dreams Game (Netflix, Thursday, 6:30 p.m., sports special) Camp Rock 3 (Disney Channel, Thursday, 7 p.m., movie premiere) Ending soon X-Men ’97 (Disney+, Wednesday, season two finale) Gone (BritBox, Thursday, season one finale)
